steps.intro: Two more songs with the melody in the right hand and bass notes in the left. Take them slowly first: the music waits for you.
steps.lightlyRow: “Lightly Row”: the left hand only plays {c3} and {g3}, one per bar.
steps.lightlyRowInTime: Now in time with the metronome.
steps.saints: “When the Saints Go Marching In”: the left hand starts alone on {c3} and moves to {g3} only in the last bar.
steps.saintsInTime: Now in time with the metronome.
steps.threeFour: The next song is in 3/4 time: three beats in each bar, the first a little stronger. And two new note lengths: a dot adds half a note’s length, so a dotted half note lasts three beats, and a dotted quarter note a beat and a half.
steps.threeFourWarmUp: Count one, two, three with the metronome: long, short, then a dotted half note for the whole bar.
steps.brahms: “Brahms’ Lullaby”, gently: the left hand plays one long note in each bar.
steps.brahmsInTime: Now in time with the metronome, softly.
